typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		PBS as string,
		ContractYRMTH as string,
		PEXCH as string,
		GMIFutCode as string,
		Quantity as string,
		Description as string,
		PSTRIK as string,
		TradeDate as string,
		PTPRIC as string,
		PutCall as string,
		PSBCUS as string,
		PACCT as string,
		PLTDAT as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource1	source(output(
		Key as string,
		Value as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> AccounttoMOsystemLookupLKPTABLE	source(output(
		Key as string,
		Value as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> EndurFutCodeLookupLKPTABLE	source(output(
		Key as string,
		{Value } as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ExchangeLookukpLKPTABLE	source(output(
		Key as string,
		Value as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> GMIMultiplierLookupforTradePriceLKPTABLE	source(output(
		Key as string,
		Value as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> LookupLKPTABLE	source(output(
		Key as string,
		Value as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> StrikeMultiplierLookupLKPTABLE
FlatFileSource1 derive(BuySell = iif(PBS == '1', 'Buy', 'Sell'),
		PEXCHAndPFC = PEXCH + GMIFutCode,
		PutCall = replace(PutCall, toString(' '), toString('')),
		PSBCUS = replace(PSBCUS, toString(' '), toString(''))) ~> DerivedColumnBuySellPEXCHAndPFC
DerivedColumnBuySellPEXCHAndPFC,EndurFutCodeLookupLKPTABLE lookup(PEXCHAndPFC == Key,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> EndurFutCodeLookup
EndurFutCodeLookup split(isMatch(), disjoint: true) ~> EndurFutCodeLookupIsMatch@(Match,NotMatch)
EndurFutCodeLookupIsMatch@NotMatch derive(EndurFutCode = 'unmapped') ~> DerivedColumn1
EndurFutCodeLookupIsMatch@NotMatch select(mapColumn(
		EndurFutCode = Value,
		BuySell = BuySell,
		PEXCHAndPFC = PEXCHAndPFC,
		PBS = PBS,
		ContractYRMTH = ContractYRMTH,
		PEXCH = PEXCH,
		GMIFutCode = GMIFutCode,
		Quantity = Quantity,
		Description = Description,
		PSTRIK = PSTRIK,
		TradeDate = TradeDate,
		PTPRIC = PTPRIC,
		PutCall = PutCall,
		PSBCUS = PSBCUS,
		PACCT = PACCT,
		PLTDAT = PLTDAT
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> EndurFutCodeLookup0
DerivedColumn1,EndurFutCodeLookup0 union(byName: true) ~> UnionAll
UnionAll,ExchangeLookukpLKPTABLE lookup(PEXCHAndPFC == Key,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> ExchangeLookukp
ExchangeLookukp split(isMatch(), disjoint: true) ~> ExchangeLookukpIsMatch@(Match,NotMatch)
ExchangeLookukpIsMatch@NotMatch derive(Exchange = PEXCH + 'unmapped') ~> DerivedColumn2
ExchangeLookukpIsMatch@NotMatch select(mapColumn(
		Exchange = {Value },
		Account = Account,
		PBS = PBS,
		ContractYRMTH = ContractYRMTH,
		PEXCH = PEXCH,
		GMIFutCode = GMIFutCode,
		Quantity = Quantity,
		Description = Description,
		PSTRIK = PSTRIK,
		TradeDate = TradeDate,
		PTPRIC = PTPRIC,
		PutCall = PutCall,
		BuySell = BuySell,
		PEXCHAndPFC = PEXCHAndPFC,
		EndurFutCode = EndurFutCode,
		PSBCUS = PSBCUS,
		PLTDAT = PLTDAT,
		PACCT = PACCT
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> ExchangeLookukp0
DerivedColumn2,ExchangeLookukp0 union(byName: true) ~> UnionAll1
UnionAll1,LookupLKPTABLE lookup(PEXCHAndPFC == Key,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Lookup
Lookup filter(isMatch()) ~> Lookup0
Lookup0 derive(Prompt2 = iif(PEXCHAndPFC == '19J\\' || PEXCHAndPFC == '19HH' || PEXCHAndPFC == '19YW' || PEXCHAndPFC == '19YY' || PEXCHAndPFC == '19SS' || PEXCHAndPFC == '19PP' || PEXCHAndPFC == '19HS' || PEXCHAndPFC == '19HM' || PEXCHAndPFC == '19YU' || PEXCHAndPFC == '19UC' || PEXCHAndPFC == '19YS' || PEXCHAndPFC == '19RS', '', PSBCUS),
		Prompt = iif(isNull(Value) == 0, Value, PSBCUS)) ~> DerrivedColumnPrompt
DerrivedColumnPrompt,StrikeMultiplierLookupLKPTABLE lookup(PEXCHAndPFC == Key,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> StrikeMultiplierLookup
StrikeMultiplierLookup select(mapColumn(
		Prompt2 = Prompt2,
		Prompt = Prompt,
		Value = DerrivedColumnPrompt@Value,
		Account = Account,
		PBS = PBS,
		ContractYRMTH = ContractYRMTH,
		PEXCH = PEXCH,
		GMIFutCode = GMIFutCode,
		Quantity = Quantity,
		Description = Description,
		PSTRIK = PSTRIK,
		TradeDate = TradeDate,
		PTPRIC = PTPRIC,
		PutCall = PutCall,
		BuySell = BuySell,
		PEXCHAndPFC = PEXCHAndPFC,
		EndurFutCode = EndurFutCode,
		Exchange = Exchange,
		PSBCUS = PSBCUS,
		PLTDAT = PLTDAT,
		PACCT = PACCT,
		Key = Key
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> StrikeMultiplierLookup01
StrikeMultiplierLookup01 split(isMatch(), disjoint: true) ~> StrikeMultiplierLookupIsMatch@(Match,NotMatch)
StrikeMultiplierLookupIsMatch@NotMatch derive(StrikeMultiplier = '1') ~> DerivedColumn3
StrikeMultiplierLookupIsMatch@NotMatch select(mapColumn(
		StrikeMultiplier = Value,
		Prompt2 = Prompt2,
		Prompt = Prompt,
		Account = Account,
		PBS = PBS,
		ContractYRMTH = ContractYRMTH,
		PEXCH = PEXCH,
		GMIFutCode = GMIFutCode,
		Quantity = Quantity,
		Description = Description,
		PSTRIK = PSTRIK,
		TradeDate = TradeDate,
		PTPRIC = PTPRIC,
		PutCall = PutCall,
		BuySell = BuySell,
		PEXCHAndPFC = PEXCHAndPFC,
		EndurFutCode = EndurFutCode,
		Exchange = Exchange,
		PSBCUS = PSBCUS,
		PLTDAT = PLTDAT,
		PACCT = PACCT
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> StrikeMultiplierLookup0
StrikeMultiplierLookup0 derive(Value = StrikeMultiplier) ~> StrikeMultiplierLookup0ONETOMANY
DerivedColumn3,StrikeMultiplierLookup0ONETOMANY union(byName: true) ~> UnionAll2
UnionAll2,GMIMultiplierLookupforTradePriceLKPTABLE lookup(PEXCHAndPFC == Key,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> GMIMultiplierLookupforTradePrice
GMIMultiplierLookupforTradePrice select(mapColumn(
		Account = Account,
		PBS = PBS,
		ContractYRMTH = ContractYRMTH,
		PEXCH = PEXCH,
		GMIFutCode = GMIFutCode,
		Quantity = Quantity,
		Description = Description,
		PSTRIK = PSTRIK,
		TradeDate = TradeDate,
		PTPRIC = PTPRIC,
		PutCall = PutCall,
		BuySell = BuySell,
		PEXCHAndPFC = PEXCHAndPFC,
		EndurFutCode = EndurFutCode,
		Exchange = Exchange,
		PSBCUS = PSBCUS,
		Value = UnionAll2@Value,
		Prompt2 = Prompt2,
		Prompt = Prompt,
		StrikeMultiplier = StrikeMultiplier,
		PLTDAT = PLTDAT,
		PACCT = PACCT,
		Key = Key
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> GMIMultiplierLookupforTradePrice01
GMIMultiplierLookupforTradePrice01 split(isMatch(), disjoint: true) ~> GMIMultiplierLookupforTradePriceIsMatch@(Match,NotMatch)
GMIMultiplierLookupforTradePriceIsMatch@NotMatch derive(GMIMultiplier = '1') ~> DerivedColumn4
GMIMultiplierLookupforTradePriceIsMatch@NotMatch select(mapColumn(
		GMIMultiplier = Value,
		Account = Account,
		PBS = PBS,
		ContractYRMTH = ContractYRMTH,
		PEXCH = PEXCH,
		GMIFutCode = GMIFutCode,
		Quantity = Quantity,
		Description = Description,
		PSTRIK = PSTRIK,
		TradeDate = TradeDate,
		PTPRIC = PTPRIC,
		PutCall = PutCall,
		BuySell = BuySell,
		PEXCHAndPFC = PEXCHAndPFC,
		EndurFutCode = EndurFutCode,
		Exchange = Exchange,
		PSBCUS = PSBCUS,
		Prompt2 = Prompt2,
		Prompt = Prompt,
		StrikeMultiplier = StrikeMultiplier,
		PLTDAT = PLTDAT,
		PACCT = PACCT
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> GMIMultiplierLookupforTradePrice0
GMIMultiplierLookupforTradePrice0 derive(Value = GMIMultiplier) ~> GMIMultiplierLookupforTradePrice0ONETOMANY
DerivedColumn4,GMIMultiplierLookupforTradePrice0ONETOMANY union(byName: true) ~> UnionAll3
UnionAll3 derive(StrikePrice = toString(PSTRIK) * toString(StrikeMultiplier),
		QuantityNumeric = toString(Quantity),
		TradePrice = toString((toString(PTPRIC) * toString(GMIMultiplier)))) ~> DerivedColumnsStrkePriceTradePriceQuantityNumeric
DerivedColumnsStrkePriceTradePriceQuantityNumeric,AccounttoMOsystemLookupLKPTABLE lookup(Account == Key,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> AccounttoMOsystemLookup
AccounttoMOsystemLookup select(mapColumn(
		StrikePrice = StrikePrice,
		QuantityNumeric = QuantityNumeric,
		TradePrice = TradePrice,
		Account = Account,
		PBS = PBS,
		ContractYRMTH = ContractYRMTH,
		PEXCH = PEXCH,
		GMIFutCode = GMIFutCode,
		Quantity = Quantity,
		Description = Description,
		PSTRIK = PSTRIK,
		TradeDate = TradeDate,
		PTPRIC = PTPRIC,
		PutCall = PutCall,
		BuySell = BuySell,
		PEXCHAndPFC = PEXCHAndPFC,
		EndurFutCode = EndurFutCode,
		Exchange = Exchange,
		PSBCUS = PSBCUS,
		Value = UnionAll3@Value,
		Prompt2 = Prompt2,
		Prompt = Prompt,
		StrikeMultiplier = StrikeMultiplier,
		GMIMultiplier = GMIMultiplier,
		PLTDAT = PLTDAT,
		PACCT = PACCT,
		Key = Key
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> AccounttoMOsystemLookup01
AccounttoMOsystemLookup01 split(isMatch(), disjoint: true) ~> AccounttoMOsystemLookupIsMatch@(Match,NotMatch)
AccounttoMOsystemLookupIsMatch@NotMatch derive(MOSystem = 'Endur') ~> DerivedColumn
AccounttoMOsystemLookupIsMatch@NotMatch select(mapColumn(
		MOSystem = Value,
		StrikePrice = StrikePrice,
		QuantityNumeric = QuantityNumeric,
		TradePrice = TradePrice,
		Account = Account,
		PBS = PBS,
		ContractYRMTH = ContractYRMTH,
		PEXCH = PEXCH,
		GMIFutCode = GMIFutCode,
		Quantity = Quantity,
		Description = Description,
		PSTRIK = PSTRIK,
		TradeDate = TradeDate,
		PTPRIC = PTPRIC,
		PutCall = PutCall,
		BuySell = BuySell,
		PEXCHAndPFC = PEXCHAndPFC,
		EndurFutCode = EndurFutCode,
		Exchange = Exchange,
		PSBCUS = PSBCUS,
		Prompt2 = Prompt2,
		Prompt = Prompt,
		StrikeMultiplier = StrikeMultiplier,
		GMIMultiplier = GMIMultiplier,
		PLTDAT = PLTDAT,
		PACCT = PACCT
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> AccounttoMOsystemLookup0
AccounttoMOsystemLookup0 derive(Value = MOSystem) ~> AccounttoMOsystemLookup0ONETOMANY
DerivedColumn,AccounttoMOsystemLookup0ONETOMANY union(byName: true) ~> UnionAll4
UnionAll4 split(MOSystem == 'Endur', disjoint: true) ~> KeepMOSystemofEndur@(MOSystemisEndur,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
KeepMOSystemofEndur@MOSystemisEndur derive(StrikePriceWithLeading0 = iif(StrikePrice < toDecimal(1), '0' + toString(StrikePrice), toString(StrikePrice))) ~> StrikePricewithLeading0
StrikePricewithLeading0 aggregate(groupBy(Account,BuySell,ContractYRMTH,EndurFutCode,Exchange,GMIFutCode,Prompt,PutCall,StrikePriceWithLeading0,TradeDate,TradePrice,PLTDAT),
	StrikePrice = last(StrikePriceWithLeading0),
		QuantityNumeric = sum(QuantityNumeric)) ~> Aggregate
StrikePricewithLeading0 aggregate(groupBy(Account,BuySell,ContractYRMTH,Description,EndurFutCode,Exchange,GMIFutCode,Prompt,PutCall,StrikePriceWithLeading0,TradeDate,TradePrice,PLTDAT),
	StrikePrice = last(StrikePriceWithLeading0)) ~> Aggregateondescriptionnotamount
Aggregate sort(asc(Account, false),asc(TradeDate, false),asc(TradePrice, false),asc(BuySell, false),asc(ContractYRMTH, false),asc(EndurFutCode, false),asc(Exchange, false),asc(GMIFutCode, false),asc(Prompt, false),asc(PutCall, false),asc(StrikePrice, false)) ~> SortoneverythingbutDescriptionandQuantity
Aggregateondescriptionnotamount sort(asc(Account, false),asc(TradeDate, false),asc(TradePrice, false),asc(Description, false),asc(PLTDAT, false),asc(BuySell, false),asc(ContractYRMTH, false),asc(EndurFutCode, false),asc(Exchange, false),asc(GMIFutCode, false),asc(Prompt, false),asc(PutCall, false),asc(StrikePrice, false)) ~> Sortoneverything
Sortoneverything derive(Account = Account) ~> PlaceHolderCalculateuniquerecordcounterwithallfieldsexceptdescription
PlaceHolderCalculateuniquerecordcounterwithallfieldsexceptdescription split(KeyCount == 1, disjoint: true) ~> ThrowoutallrecordswhereKeyCountisgreatherthanonetherebysavingthefirstdescriptionperkey@(FirstKeyOccurence,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
SortoneverythingbutDescriptionandQuantity,ThrowoutallrecordswhereKeyCountisgreatherthanonetherebysavingthefirstdescriptionperkey@FirstKeyOccurence join(Aggregate@Account == ThrowoutallrecordswhereKeyCountisgreatherthanonetherebysavingthefirstdescriptionperkey@FirstKeyOccurence@Account && Aggregate@BuySell == ThrowoutallrecordswhereKeyCountisgreatherthanonetherebysavingthefirstdescriptionperkey@FirstKeyOccurence@BuySell && Aggregate@ContractYRMTH == ThrowoutallrecordswhereKeyCountisgreatherthanonetherebysavingthefirstdescriptionperkey@FirstKeyOccurence@ContractYRMTH && Aggregate@EndurFutCode == ThrowoutallrecordswhereKeyCountisgreatherthanonetherebysavingthefirstdescriptionperkey@FirstKeyOccurence@EndurFutCode && Aggregate@Exchange == ThrowoutallrecordswhereKeyCountisgreatherthanonetherebysavingthefirstdescriptionperkey@FirstKeyOccurence@Exchange && Aggregate@GMIFutCode == ThrowoutallrecordswhereKeyCountisgreatherthanonetherebysavingthefirstdescriptionperkey@FirstKeyOccurence@GMIFutCode && Aggregate@Prompt == ThrowoutallrecordswhereKeyCountisgreatherthanonetherebysavingthefirstdescriptionperkey@FirstKeyOccurence@Prompt && Aggregate@PutCall == ThrowoutallrecordswhereKeyCountisgreatherthanonetherebysavingthefirstdescriptionperkey@FirstKeyOccurence@PutCall && Aggregate@StrikePrice == ThrowoutallrecordswhereKeyCountisgreatherthanonetherebysavingthefirstdescriptionperkey@FirstKeyOccurence@StrikePrice && Aggregate@TradeDate == ThrowoutallrecordswhereKeyCountisgreatherthanonetherebysavingthefirstdescriptionperkey@FirstKeyOccurence@TradeDate && Aggregate@TradePrice == ThrowoutallrecordswhereKeyCountisgreatherthanonetherebysavingthefirstdescriptionperkey@FirstKeyOccurence@TradePrice,
	joinType:'inner',
	broadcast: 'none')~> MergeJoin
MergeJoin select(mapColumn(
		Account = ThrowoutallrecordswhereKeyCountisgreatherthanonetherebysavingthefirstdescriptionperkey@FirstKeyOccurence@Account,
		BuySell = ThrowoutallrecordswhereKeyCountisgreatherthanonetherebysavingthefirstdescriptionperkey@FirstKeyOccurence@BuySell,
		ContractYRMTH = ThrowoutallrecordswhereKeyCountisgreatherthanonetherebysavingthefirstdescriptionperkey@FirstKeyOccurence@ContractYRMTH,
		EndurFutCode = ThrowoutallrecordswhereKeyCountisgreatherthanonetherebysavingthefirstdescriptionperkey@FirstKeyOccurence@EndurFutCode,
		Exchange = ThrowoutallrecordswhereKeyCountisgreatherthanonetherebysavingthefirstdescriptionperkey@FirstKeyOccurence@Exchange,
		GMIFutCode = ThrowoutallrecordswhereKeyCountisgreatherthanonetherebysavingthefirstdescriptionperkey@FirstKeyOccurence@GMIFutCode,
		Prompt = ThrowoutallrecordswhereKeyCountisgreatherthanonetherebysavingthefirstdescriptionperkey@FirstKeyOccurence@Prompt,
		PutCall = ThrowoutallrecordswhereKeyCountisgreatherthanonetherebysavingthefirstdescriptionperkey@FirstKeyOccurence@PutCall,
		StrikePrice = ThrowoutallrecordswhereKeyCountisgreatherthanonetherebysavingthefirstdescriptionperkey@FirstKeyOccurence@StrikePrice,
		TradeDate = ThrowoutallrecordswhereKeyCountisgreatherthanonetherebysavingthefirstdescriptionperkey@FirstKeyOccurence@TradeDate,
		TradePrice = TradePrice,
		QuantityNumeric = QuantityNumeric,
		Description = Description,
		PLTDAT = PLTDAT
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> MergeJoin01
MergeJoin01 derive(Account = Account,
		BuySell = BuySell,
		ContractYRMTH = ContractYRMTH,
		EndurFutCode = EndurFutCode,
		Exchange = Exchange,
		GMIFutCode = GMIFutCode,
		Prompt = Prompt,
		PutCall = PutCall,
		StrikePrice = StrikePrice,
		TradeDate = TradeDate,
		TradePrice = TradePrice,
		QuantityNumeric = QuantityNumeric,
		Description = Description,
		PLTDAT = PLTDAT) ~> MergeJoin0
MergeJoin0 derive(StrikePriceString = toString(StrikePrice),
		PLTDATE2 = substring(toString(PLTDAT), toInteger(5), toInteger(2)) + '/' + substring(toString(PLTDAT), toInteger(7), toInteger(2)) + '/' + substring(toString(PLTDAT), toInteger(1), toInteger(4))) ~> Explictilycastingstrikepricetoastringasdefaultcastwastruncating
Explictilycastingstrikepricetoastringasdefaultcastwastruncating sink(input(
		Account as string,
		Description as string,
		StrikePrice as string,
		ContractYRMTH as string,
		GMIFutCode as string,
		Quantity as string,
		BuySell as string,
		TradePrice as string,
		Exchange as string,
		PutCall as string,
		LastTradeDate as string,
		TradeDate as string,
		Prompt as string,
		EndurFutCode as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Account,
		Description,
		StrikePrice = StrikePriceString,
		ContractYRMTH,
		GMIFutCode,
		Quantity = QuantityNumeric,
		BuySell,
		TradePrice,
		Exchange,
		PutCall,
		LastTradeDate = PLTDATE2,
		TradeDate,
		Prompt,
		EndurFutCode)) ~> FlatFileDestination
